narrative.overview: FaceScan uses neutral charcoal surfaces, restrained green selection, and clear control boundaries for local biometric workflows. The native operating interface prioritizes tasks, evidence, and readable data, with particular attention to webcam recognition and video analysis.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained green state and action accents

rules.name: Shared Surface Rule
rules.body: Set native QPalette roles as well as QSS so viewports and auto-filled containers retain the dark system.

dos: Do use shared QSS and QPalette for new controls.
Do preserve visible focus and semantic states.
Do check both languages and compact layouts.
donts: Don't add retro blue-black chrome or decorative neon glows.
Don't conceal native controls or existing functionality for decoration.
